playwright.description: Full browser control (navigate/snapshot/click/type/vision/network/pdf). Human-paced via browser-ops skill; CAPTCHAs go to operator_ping gate, never auto-solved.

memory.description: Persistent knowledge graph — challenge profiles, technique priors, FP patterns across sessions

sequential-thinking.description: Multi-step reasoning — flag-path synthesis, exploit planning

cyberchef.description: CyberChef recipes (bake/search/describe) — crypto + forensics encodings. Verified 2026-10-15.

mdb.description: GDB debugger sessions (status/start/command/interrupt/terminate). Local binaries only. Verified 2026-10-15.

filesystem.description: Scoped file access (challenges/ + results/ only). Verified 2026-10-15.

volatility.description: Volatility3 memory forensics (vendored Linux-patched server). Verified 2026-10-15.

ctfd.description: CTFd platform (list/submit/containers). Enable per CTFd event: export CTFD_URL + CTFD_TOKEN, then flip enabled=true. See start.sh.

htb-ctf.description: Official HTB CTF MCP. Enable per HTB event: Bearer MCP token from HTB profile -> Authorization header. See start.sh.

ctf-toolkit.description: 126-tool CTF kit. SANDBOX-ONLY (14 RCE-class tools); enable per-task inside docker, then disable.

ghidra.description: GhidraMCP headless (28 RE tools). Enabled by default; per rev task set GHIDRA_BINARY=/path/to/target. Anytime CLI: tools/rev_ghidra.py --binary <f> --decompile <fn>.

burp.description: Burp Suite Pro MCP (Den-Sec/burp-mcp, 61 tools). DISABLED by default (no Burp Pro here). To enable: cd extension && ./gradlew jar, load extension/build/libs/burp-mcp-extension-2.0.0.jar in Burp Pro, pip install -e server/, export BURP_API_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8089) + BURP_API_KEY, then flip enabled=true. Web fallback: ffuf/sqlmap CLI.

brave-search.description: Web search for OSINT dorking. Enable per OSINT task: export BRAVE_API_KEY first. NEVER send flags to it (local-only policy).

github.description: GitHub code search for OSINT. Enable per OSINT task: export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN first.

worker.description: Spawns the Worker subagent to execute a CTF framework task
worker.template: Read `master_prompt.md`, `worker_prompt.md`, `challenge_prompt.md`, and `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`. Execute exactly one bounded task from the operator: $ARGUMENTS. Before acting, identify challenge ID, scope, budget, expected artifact, and stop condition; if any are missing, record them as unknown and ask the Lead/operator rather than guessing. Return a durable evidence-based result artifact; do not submit flags.

triage.description: Runs Phase 0 triage/classification on challenge files
triage.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/triage/SKILL.md`. Triage exactly the challenge specified: $ARGUMENTS. Inspect the provided files and statement; run the bounded offline quick-win sweep where applicable. Use file/content signals over list-page labels. Write the requested surface.json with evidence, confidence, primary/secondary routes, unknowns, and artifact paths. Do not exploit during triage. Ambiguous evidence stays LOW/unknown; never force a category.

recon.description: Runs Phase 1 surface expansion for a challenge
recon.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, the task, and the referenced category skill. Perform bounded, in-scope reconnaissance for: $ARGUMENTS. Confirm the supplied target and scope first. Record endpoint/field/file/behavior observations with exact evidence and useful negatives. Do not exploit or broaden scope; stop on CAPTCHA, login, 429, or ambiguous authorization. Return a prioritized surface update and next falsifiable hypotheses.

analyze.description: Runs Phase 2 deep analysis / profiling (maps to /map)
analyze.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, the task, and the referenced category skill. Analyze exactly the assigned challenge: $ARGUMENTS. Separate observed facts, inferences, and unknowns. Produce a profile with at most three ranked hypotheses; each must include preconditions, supporting evidence, a predicted observation, a falsifier, cost, and a bounded next test. Do not invent an EXP result or run unrelated probes.

exploit.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, the task, and the referenced skill. Test exactly one assigned EXP hypothesis: $ARGUMENTS. Write a minimal reproducer at the task's artifact path, use explicit time/request caps, and prefer local reproduction. Run only actions in scope. Record the real command, output path, version, elapsed time, controls, and verdict (CONFIRMED/NEGATIVE/PARTIAL). A flag-shaped string is only a candidate; do not claim accepted/correct without independent validation. Never submit.

validate.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and the task. Validate exactly the assigned reproducer: $ARGUMENTS. Use a clean process/container or fresh challenge instance where available; document reset assumptions. Compare output against the challenge-stated answer format or success oracle. Distinguish candidate, reproduced, accepted, and unverified. Do not submit or expose the answer in chat; store sensitive answers only in the designated local file.

writeup.template: Read `skills/report-writeup/SKILL.md` and `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`. Create a writeup only from validated artifacts for: $ARGUMENTS. Separate observed facts from interpretation, cite source/artifact paths, include failed approaches only when evidenced, redact answer values from the writeup unless event rules explicitly require them in the private per-event writeup, and never ingest secrets into shared knowledge.

solve.description: Lead macro: full triage-to-exploit loop for one CHAL-ID
solve.template: Act as Lead. Read `master_prompt.md`, `lead_prompt.md`, `challenge_prompt.md`, `state.json`, `skills/index.md`, and `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`. Solve only the named challenge: $ARGUMENTS. Confirm it is in scope and registered. Do not run tactical shell/network/debug/exploit commands yourself; dispatch bounded Worker tasks using `/triage`, `/recon`, `/analyze`, `/exploit`, `/validate` and review their artifacts. Ensure the worker runs `tools/autosolve.py` before expensive work when applicable. Use evidence-based triage, at most three ranked hypotheses, one hypothesis per exploit task, and at most three bounded attempts total (corrected retry + one alternate). Validate in a clean run against the challenge-defined answer format/oracle; regex syntax alone is not correctness. Do not submit; submission remains an operator hard gate through `/submit` and `tools/submit.py`. On a blocker, record it and continue any independent in-scope work.

pwn.description: Pwn specialist worker (checksec → offset → leak → ROP)
pwn.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/pwn/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded pwn task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Establish architecture/protections and input control before payload construction; prove leaks and offsets on the same binary/runtime; validate locally before remote interaction.

crypto.description: Crypto specialist worker (classifier → RsaCtfTool → oracle → classical)
crypto.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/crypto/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded crypto task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Identify the primitive/parameters first, select one attack whose preconditions match, use exact integer/modular arithmetic, and verify by re-encryption/signature/oracle consistency. Bound factoring, brute force, and lattice runs.

rev.description: Rev specialist worker (Ghidra → angr → Frida → re-implement)
rev.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/rev/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded reverse-engineering task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Fingerprint architecture/runtime/packing, trace from the success check, use static before dynamic, and verify the recovered input against the original challenge binary.

web.description: Web-CTF specialist worker (fuzz matrix → vuln checklist)
web.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, `skills/web-ctf/SKILL.md`, and event scope. Execute the bounded web-CTF task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Start with low-impact recon and a discriminating probe. Use Playwright for rendered behavior when needed. On CAPTCHA/login/2FA/429, stop and hand off to the operator; never evade the gate.

forensics.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/forensics/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded forensics task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Work read-only on copies, hash originals, record tool versions and offsets, and preserve a reproducible extraction chain.

stego.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/stego/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded stego task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Preserve original bytes, identify the carrier format before selecting a tool, and validate extracted data by type, hash, and challenge context.

misc.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/misc-pyjail/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded misc/pyjail task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Inspect the exact parser, runtime version, filter, and allowed input before choosing a construction; test locally first when code is supplied.

osint.description: OSINT specialist worker (handles, domains, archives, metadata)
osint.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, `skills/osint/SKILL.md`, and the CTF's explicit OSINT scope. Execute the bounded task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Use only provided fictional CTF personas/data and allowed public sources. GitHub/Brave MCPs are optional and may be disabled; never assume they are available. Do not contact people, submit real emails, bypass login/CAPTCHA, or expand scope.

hardware.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/hardware/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded hardware task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Prefer supplied dumps and simulations; never toggle fuses, write firmware, or alter physical devices without explicit authorization. Record board/chip/tool versions and preserve original captures.

blockchain.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/blockchain/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded blockchain task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Use local Anvil/fork state only; inspect challenge win condition and public getters first, pin block/compiler, and do not send transactions to mainnet or unrelated networks.

mobile.description: Mobile specialist worker (APK/IPA static + Frida dynamic)
mobile.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/mobile/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded mobile task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Static analysis first; dynamic hooks only on the supplied app/emulator. Do not upload APKs, tokens, or captured answers to third-party services.

ai-ml.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, `skills/ai-ml/SKILL.md`, and the challenge scope. Execute the bounded AI/ML task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Use only the challenge's model/tool endpoint. Never send real flags, credentials, cookies, or private data to hosted models or external listeners; use synthetic canaries. Do not test unrelated public AI services.

browser.description: Browser extraction worker (CDP-attached operator Chrome → challenges + files)
browser.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/browser-ops/SKILL.md`. Execute the bounded browser task exactly as assigned: $ARGUMENTS. Use the correct isolated browser profile; attach to the operator's authenticated Chrome only for platform sessions. Never fill credentials or solve/bypass CAPTCHA. Serialize actions per profile, pace requests, verify downloaded bytes and hashes, and stop on access/rate gates.

submit.description: Paced, gated flag submission (clearance pre-flight, ledger, budget)
submit.template: This command crosses a hard gate. Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, `docs/LIVE_OPS.md` sections 1-4, and `tools/submit.py --help`. Do not submit unless the operator explicitly authorizes this exact challenge and candidate in the current request. Use `tools/submit.py` only; honor event attempt limits, pacing, expected format, and duplicate ledger. Never guess or auto-submit. Task: $ARGUMENTS

instance.template: Read `worker_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `docs/LIVE_OPS.md` section 7. Use `tools/instance.py` only for the named in-scope CTF instance; record expiry/reset behavior and never spawn unrelated targets. Task: $ARGUMENTS

think.description: Sequential multi-step reasoning for flag-path synthesis
think.template: Read `master_prompt.md`, `skills/_shared/SKILL_CONTRACT.md`, and `skills/sequential-thinking/SKILL.md`. Analyze the stated challenge using observed facts, unknowns, at most three falsifiable hypotheses, and the cheapest discriminating test. Do not invent observations. Task: $ARGUMENTS

status.description: Shows current CTF session status from state.json
status.template: Read `state.json` and summarize competition/status, challenge counts by status, validated-answer count (never print answer values), blockers, and one next priority action. If this is the pristine template, say no engagement has been initialized and point to `./start.sh`; do not infer a competition from history.

resume.description: Resumes CTF session from last state
resume.template: Act as Lead. Read `master_prompt.md`, `lead_prompt.md`, `challenge_prompt.md`, `skills/index.md`, `phases/PHASE_ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `state.json`. The template state is intentionally empty; if not initialized, point to `./start.sh` and do not invent event data. Otherwise inventory remaining in-scope challenges, blockers, last evidence, budgets, and answer validation status. Choose and dispatch the next bounded Worker task using `/triage`, `/recon`, `/analyze`, `/exploit`, or `/validate`; do not stop at merely recommending a task when dispatch is authorized. Do not submit.
